edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the current user for cooldown tracking and as effective transfer source inside _transfer.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _FeeAddress.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _FeeAddress.
setFeeRate authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() with _FeeAddress.
setCooldownEnabled uses onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
openTrading uses onlyOwner verifying the caller is the owner.
addLiquidity uses onlyOwner verifying the caller is the owner.
block.timestamp drives buy-limit and sell-cooldown requirements in _transfer.
buyLimitEnd is set to block.timestamp plus 120 seconds in openTrading.
cooldown buy and sell timestamps are derived from block.timestamp.
_transfer delegates final token movement to _tokenTransfer with the computed takeFee flag.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard to update reflection balances.
_transfer performs an external swap via swapTokensForEth before completing its own accounting.
_transfer sends ETH to fee wallets before finishing state updates.
swapTokensForEth makes an external router call swapping tokens for ETH.
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
addLiquidity makes an external payable router call adding liquidity.
Post-swap code continues to update _rOwned balances, allowing reentrancy before final state updates.
_transfer ultimately reads and writes reflection balances in _rOwned.
_transfer reads inSwap to guard the sell-side swap path.
_transfer writes _taxFee to 6 on buys and adjusts it on sells.
_transfer writes _teamFee to 4 on buys and adjusts it on sells.
_transfer reads _cooldownEnabled to decide cooldown enforcement.
_transfer requires tradingOpen before allowing pair transfers.
_transfer compares transfer amount against _maxBuyAmount during the buy-limit window.
_transfer uses _feeRate to cap the contract token balance swapped.
_transfer reads uniswapV2Pair to distinguish buys from sells.
_transfer calls setFee with the computed fee basis, recomputing tax and team fees.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit team fees.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to reduce total reflections.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
transferFrom decrements the allowance stored in _allowances.
transfer forwards msg.sender and recipient to _transfer.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take a fee.
from parameter flows into _transfer logic.
to parameter flows into _transfer logic.
amount parameter flows into _transfer fee and limit arithmetic.
